title: Invoice Total Amount
prompt: A C# billing worker needs the total amount across invoices. Write a function that adds every amount value and returns the total.

explanation.beginner: Start by identifying what the function receives and what it must return. For Invoice Total Amount, read the story as a simple input-to-output rule: A C# billing worker needs the total amount across invoices. Write a function that adds every amount value and returns the total. Work through one small example by hand, then write the steps in C# using plain variables before worrying about making the code shorter.
